StoreSettings.title: StoreSettings
StoreSettings.description: Single-product catalog configuration, weight variants, BDT pricing, delivery fees, payment numbers, and store metadata.

Order.title: Order
Order.description: Customer order record containing verified pricing, delivery address, payment details, and fulfillment status.

OrderTracking.title: OrderTracking
OrderTracking.description: PII-isolated public status lookup keyed by OrderNumber_Phone for customer order tracking.

BatchRecord.title: BatchRecord
BatchRecord.description: Authentic batch provenance, milk origin, production/expiry dates, and lab report reference for QR verification.

Review.title: Review
Review.description: Customer review moderated by Admin before appearing on the storefront.

Coupon.title: Coupon
Coupon.description: Promotional coupon code managed by Admin.

ChatbotConfig.title: ChatbotConfig
ChatbotConfig.description: Admin-managed AI customer support knowledge base settings, brand/product truths, business hours, custom instructions, and quick questions.

ChatbotConfigVersion.title: ChatbotConfigVersion
ChatbotConfigVersion.description: Published snapshot of ChatbotConfig for admin version rollback.

ChatbotFaq.title: ChatbotFaq
ChatbotFaq.description: Admin-managed bilingual FAQ entry retrieved by the AI chatbot.

ChatbotKbDoc.title: ChatbotKbDoc
ChatbotKbDoc.description: Approved knowledge base entry or uploaded document text (TXT, CSV, PDF, DOCX) for RAG retrieval.

ChatbotLog.title: ChatbotLog
ChatbotLog.description: Sanitized append-only conversation turn log, unanswered question record, and Gemini token/cost analytics.

ChatbotSupportRequest.title: ChatbotSupportRequest
ChatbotSupportRequest.description: Customer-consented human customer support handover request with SLA metadata, private evidence references, and inbox triage state.

ChatbotUsedToken.title: ChatbotUsedToken
ChatbotUsedToken.description: Single-use confirmation token consumption lock preventing order token replay and double-submit.

ChatbotOrderIdempotency.title: ChatbotOrderIdempotency
ChatbotOrderIdempotency.description: Hashed order idempotency key mapping repeated submissions to the original orderNumber without PII.

ChatbotRateBucket.title: ChatbotRateBucket
ChatbotRateBucket.description: Persistent hashed rate-limit bucket counter across serverless instances.

ChatbotCostLedger.title: ChatbotCostLedger
ChatbotCostLedger.description: Persistent daily token and estimated USD cost ledger for daily cost-cap circuit breaking.

KnowledgeChunk.title: KnowledgeChunk
KnowledgeChunk.description: Indexed overlapping RAG chunk derived from ChatbotKbDoc with optional semantic embedding.

ChatSession.title: ChatSession
ChatSession.description: Server-persisted chat session language lock, script preference, and active order draft link.

OrderDraft.title: OrderDraft
OrderDraft.description: Server-side TTL-bounded guided order state machine tracking slots and quote version.

ChatbotFeedback.title: ChatbotFeedback
ChatbotFeedback.description: Customer CSAT thumbs-up/down and negative feedback reason for continuous improvement.

OrderFingerprint.title: OrderFingerprint
OrderFingerprint.description: Zero-PII SHA-256 fingerprint hash detecting duplicate orders within 2 hours.

OrderAuditLog.title: OrderAuditLog
OrderAuditLog.description: Immutable append-only order lifecycle audit trail (create, edit_address, cancel, review).

SupportEvidence.title: SupportEvidence
SupportEvidence.description: Private customer-uploaded damage claim or payment dispute image stored securely for Admin-only inspection.

SupportAgentReply.title: SupportAgentReply
SupportAgentReply.description: Immutable Admin agent reply record linked to a support ticket and customer chat session.

OrderReviewClaim.title: OrderReviewClaim
OrderReviewClaim.description: Zero-PII lock enforcing at most one verified purchase review per delivered orderNumber.

RefillReminder.title: RefillReminder
RefillReminder.description: Customer opt-in post-delivery ghee refill reminder schedule keyed by {orderNumber}_{phone}.

ChannelWebhookEvent.title: ChannelWebhookEvent
ChannelWebhookEvent.description: Idempotent immutable webhook delivery lock preventing duplicate Messenger, Instagram, and WhatsApp webhook processing.

MarketingConsent.title: MarketingConsent
MarketingConsent.description: Customer opt-in consent and instant unsubscribe suppression record keyed by verified Bangladesh phone number.

PaymentGatewayEvent.title: PaymentGatewayEvent
PaymentGatewayEvent.description: Immutable idempotent record for server-verified SSLCommerz, bKash, and courier webhook events.

IntegrationSettings.title: IntegrationSettings
IntegrationSettings.description: Non-secret operational integration toggles and channel connection metadata for Telegram, Discord, WhatsApp, and AI Support.

NotificationRules.title: NotificationRules
NotificationRules.description: Per-event notification routing matrix and exponential backoff retry thresholds.

NotificationEvent.title: NotificationEvent
NotificationEvent.description: Deduplicated business event ledger record keyed by deterministic idempotencyKey.

NotificationJob.title: NotificationJob
NotificationJob.description: Durable per-channel notification dispatch job with exponential backoff and dead-letter queue status.

NotificationLog.title: NotificationLog
NotificationLog.description: Immutable delivery attempt audit log with sanitized errors and external message IDs.

/store_settings/{docId}.description: Public storefront configuration ('main' doc) editable only by Admin.

/orders/{orderId}.description: Full customer orders containing PII, readable and updatable only by Admin.

/order_tracking/{lookupId}.description: Sanitized public order tracking status keyed by {orderNumber}_{phone}.

/batches/{batchId}.description: Batch verification records for QR code provenance lookup.

/reviews/{reviewId}.description: Moderated customer reviews; public reads approved reviews only.

/coupons/{code}.description: Promotional discount codes managed by Admin.

/chatbot_config/{docId}.description: Published ('published') and admin draft ('draft') chatbot knowledge base configuration.

/chatbot_config_versions/{versionId}.description: Version snapshots of published chatbot configurations for Admin restore.

/chatbot_faqs/{faqId}.description: Admin-managed FAQ entries; public reads only active & published FAQs.

/chatbot_kb_docs/{docId}.description: Knowledge base text entries and uploaded document extracts; public reads published public-scope docs only.

/chatbot_logs/{logId}.description: Append-only conversation logs, unanswered questions, and Gemini API usage metrics readable only by Admin.

/chatbot_support_requests/{reqId}.description: Consented human customer support handover requests readable and updatable only by Admin.

/chatbot_used_tokens/{tokenId}.description: Atomic single-use confirmation token locks tied to created orders.

/chatbot_order_idempotency/{idemKey}.description: PII-free idempotency lock records keyed by hashed order attributes.

/chatbot_rate_buckets/{bucketId}.description: Hashed rate-limit counters shared across serverless instances.

/chatbot_cost_ledger/{dateKey}.description: Persistent daily Gemini API usage & estimated USD cost ledger for circuit breaking.

/knowledge_chunks/{chunkId}.description: Indexed overlapping KB chunks; public reads only published + public accessScope chunks.

/chat_sessions/{sessionId}.description: Server-persisted chat session state (lockedLang, scriptPreference, turnCount) readable by exact sessionId only.

/order_drafts/{draftId}.description: Server-persisted TTL-bounded order draft slots & priceQuoteVersion readable by exact draftId only.

/chatbot_feedback/{feedbackId}.description: Customer CSAT feedback records (thumbs up/down + reason) readable and triaged by Admin.

/order_fingerprints/{fingerprintId}.description: Zero-PII duplicate order fingerprint hashes keyed by SHA-256.

/order_audit_logs/{logId}.description: Immutable append-only audit log entries linked to orders readable by Admin.

/support_evidence/{evidenceId}.description: Private customer-uploaded evidence images readable only by verified Admin.

/support_agent_replies/{replyId}.description: Immutable human support replies sent from Admin inbox into customer chat sessions.

/order_review_claims/{orderNumber}.description: Single-claim atomic lock ensuring at most one verified review per delivered orderNumber.

/refill_reminders/{reminderId}.description: Customer opt-in post-delivery refill reminders keyed by {orderNumber}_{phone}.

/channel_webhook_events/{eventId}.description: Immutable idempotent webhook event ledger for Messenger, Instagram, and WhatsApp Cloud.

/marketing_consents/{phoneKey}.description: Customer marketing opt-in and unsubscribe suppression registry keyed by Bangladesh phone.

/payment_gateway_events/{eventId}.description: Immutable idempotent event ledger for SSLCommerz/bKash payment verification and live courier webhook sync.

/integration_settings/{docId}.description: Non-secret integration toggles & connection status metadata ('main' doc), strictly Admin-only.

/notification_rules/{docId}.description: Per-event notification channel rules and retry thresholds ('main' doc), strictly Admin-only.

/notification_events/{eventKey}.description: Deduplicated business event ledger keyed by idempotencyKey, strictly Admin-only.

/notification_jobs/{jobId}.description: Durable per-channel notification queue & dead-letter jobs, strictly Admin-only.

/notification_logs/{logId}.description: Sanitized append-only notification delivery attempt logs, strictly Admin-only.
